Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89410575136
Zoom Meeting ID: 894 1057 5136
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 894 1057 5136#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.

INCORPORATED 1939

  MlNUTES
  OF THE JANUARY 26, 2021 REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant
to Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called
to order by Mayor Kemps at 6:30 P.M. on January 26, 2021 , notice having been given with
affidavit thereto on file. Members of the public were provided with the following information
to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/i189410575136
  Zoom Meeting ID: 894 1057 5136
  BY TELEPHONE: 1669900 9128, Enter Code: 894 1057 5136#
  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are
available on the City's website under City Council Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R21-04

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 021-748

CALL TO ORDER 6:31 P.M.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENT:  Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, Roos and
  Murdock

ALSO PRESENT:
  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti, Treasurer Greenberg, Acting
  Police Chief Best, Acting Planning & Building Director Rindge, City Support
  Services Director Hannah, City Clerk Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, seconded by Councilmember
  Murdock to approve the agenda.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos , McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

MAYOR'S REPORT - MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST

Mayor Kemps noted the upcoming meetings for the Housing and Safety Element Kick-off, the
Police Ad Hoc Committee Report and the Goal Setting Workshop.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
JANUARY 26, 2021
 City Manager Guglielmo provided updates regarding George Allen Field, Malaga Cove traffic
control, and State and County public health orders.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

The following individuals addressed the City Council: Bob Steams, Desiree Myers

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 -5)

Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi requested that item #5 be removed from the Consent Agenda.

1.  City Council Action Minutes

  Reviewed and Approved:
  a.  January 11 , 2021 Special Meeting Minutes
  b.  January 13, 2021 Special Closed Session Meeting Minutes
  c.  January 13, 2021 Regular Meeting Minutes

2.  Approval of Warrant Registers

  Reviewed and Approved Warrant Registers: 01262021-A, 0126202 1-B, 01262021-
  C, 01262021-D, 01262021-E, 01222021-A

3.  Planning Commission Actions of January 19, 2021

  Received and Filed.

4.  Adoption of State Mandated Covid-19 Prevention Program

  Approved the adoption of the COVID-19 Prevention Program (CPP) mandated by
  California Occupational Safety and Health Standards Board (CalOSHA).

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi
  to approve the Consent Agenda items 1-4.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos , McGowan, Lozzi , Kemps
  NOES:  None

ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT AGENDA

5.  Adoption of Resolution R21-05 Approving: (1) a Contract Amendment for Fire
  Safety Weed Abatement Services and (2) a Supplemental Appropriation in the
  Amount of $30,360 for Fiscal Year 2020/2021 from the General Fund Unassigned
  Fund Balance with Travers Tree Service, Inc.

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, seconded by Councilmember McGowan
  to adopt proposed Resolution R21-05 approving: ( 1) a contract amendment for fire
  safety weed abatement services and (2) a supplemental appropriation in the amount of
  $30,360 via Budget Transfer for Fiscal Year 2020/2021 with Travers Tree Service,
  Inc.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi , Kemps
  NOES:  None

CEREMONIAL MATTERS

PUBLIC HEARING(S)

OLD BUSINESS

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
JANUARY 26 , 2021
 6.  Palos Verdes Drive West Corridor Expansion Project Update

  Tim Jonasson provided the update. Received and Filed.

NEW BUSINESS

7.  Consideration of a Resolution to Oppose California Senate Bill 9 (Atkins) that
  undermines local land use decisions and Authorize the Mayor to sign a position
  letter on this bill.

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Roos, seconded by Councilmember McGowan
  to authorize the Mayor to sign a position letter, working with the City Manager to
  voice the City's strong opposition to SB 9.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Murdock, seconded by Mayor Kemps to bring
  Senate Bill 10 to the City Council for future consideration.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

8.  Consideration of a letter of expectations to the League Of California Cities that
  it support legislation that fulfills its mission and oppose all legislation that erodes
  local control in housing, planning and zoning decisions, and authorizing the
  Mayor to sign such a letter on behalf of the City.

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Roos, seconded by Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi to
  authorize the Mayor and City Manager to compose a letter expressing the City's firm
  desire that the League of California Cities represent the City' s interest in opposing
  legislation that erodes local control in housing, planning and zoning decisions which
  includes a statement that the City would reconsider its membership if the League fails
  to fulfill its mission.

  AYES:  Murdock, Roos, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

9.  Receive and File a presentation from the City Manager and the Director of City
  Support Services regarding (A) Mid-Year (to December 31, 2020) Financial
  Reports and Budget Assessment; (B) Financial Projections for Fiscal Year 2020-
  21; and (C) Review of an Updated Draft Version of the Long-Term Financial
  Plan.

  Desiree Myers and Joan Davidson addressed the City Council.

  Received and filed a presentation from the Director of City Support Services related
  to the Mid-Year Financial Condition and Budget Assessment (to December 31 , 2020),
  (B) Financial Projections for Fiscal Year 2020-21 , and (C) Reviewed of an updated
  DRAFT version of the Long-Term Financial Plan.

 MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

 Councilmember McGowan noted the Police Ad Hoc report and presentation.

 Councilmember Murdock requested that the Revenue Workshop be scheduled.

 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
 JANUARY 26 , 2021
 Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi reported that she attended a Govlnvest Webinar, reiterated her request of
future agenda items for parking and the HR Green Report.

Mayor Kemps reported that there is a petition going around lower Malaga Cove regarding the
parking and traffic situation.

Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, February 9th, 2021AT6:30 P.M.

ADJOURNMENT

  ACTION: Moved by Councilmember McGowan, Seconded by Councilmember Roos
  to adjourn the meeting at 9:38 p.m.

  AYES:  Roos, Murdock, McGowan, Lozzi, Kemps
  NOES:  None

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  APPROVED:

  Michael Kemps, Mayor

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES
JANUARY 26 , 2021
